en: Black‑and‑white image of a massive rectangular stone castle or fortress perched dramatically on a steep rocky cliff above a winding river. The walls are largely unornamented, with a few narrow windows and small towers or turrets at the corners, one with a conical roof. Below the keep are remnants of round defensive works integrated into the cliff. In the distance, a valley with fields and forested hills follows the river. The upper left of the image is partially obscured by a dark triangular area, suggesting damage or cropping. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.
